hindi: बलूत का फल — ओक के पेड़ पर लगने वाला छोटा, चिकना, अंडाकार मेवा जिस पर टोपी जैसा आवरण होता है
definition: a small, smooth, oval nut with a woody cap, which grows on oak trees and is eaten by squirrels
example: The squirrel hid an acorn under the leaves and promptly forgot where it was.

hindi: हवाई जहाज़ — पंखों और इंजन वाली बड़ी सवारी जो आसमान में उड़कर लोगों को दूर ले जाती है
definition: a large flying vehicle with fixed wings and engines that carries passengers or goods through the air
example: The aeroplane rose above the clouds, and the city shrank to toy size.

hindi: एम्बुलेंस — बीमार या घायल लोगों को जल्दी अस्पताल पहुँचाने वाली ख़ास गाड़ी
definition: a van with flashing lights and a siren that rushes sick or injured people to hospital
example: The ambulance swept past us, and every car made room at once.

hindi: चींटी — एक छोटा-सा कीड़ा जो झुंड में रहता है और मीठी चीज़ों की ओर खिंचा चला आता है
definition: a tiny insect with six legs and a narrow waist that lives in large groups and carries food back to its nest
example: A line of ants marched across the kitchen floor, carrying one tiny crumb of cake.

hindi: सेब — लाल या हरे छिलके वाला एक गोल, मीठा और रसीला फल
definition: a round fruit with crisp white flesh and red, green or yellow skin, growing on trees in cool climates
example: She packed a shiny red apple in her bag for the long train journey.

hindi: बैकपैक — पीठ पर टाँगा जाने वाला, दो पट्टियों वाला बड़ा थैला
definition: a bag with two shoulder straps, carried on the back and used for books, clothes and other things
example: He packed a sandwich, a water bottle and two comics into his backpack.

hindi: गुब्बारा — हवा भरने पर फूल जाने वाली रबड़ की रंगीन थैली
definition: a thin rubber bag that swells into a round shape when filled with air or gas, used for parties and play
example: Every child at the party left holding a balloon and a slice of cake.

hindi: बाँस — एक ऊँची, सीधी घास जिसके खोखले, गाँठदार हरे तने से छड़ें और फ़र्नीचर बनते हैं
definition: a tall, woody grass with hollow, jointed green stems, used to make furniture, poles and scaffolding in many parts of Asia
example: We built a small garden fence out of bamboo, and the neighbours were quite jealous.

hindi: केला — पीले छिलके वाला एक लंबा, मुड़ा हुआ और मीठा फल
definition: a long curved fruit with soft sweet flesh inside a yellow skin that you peel before eating
example: The monkey peeled the banana very slowly, as if the whole zoo were watching him.

hindi: खलिहान — खेत के पास बना बड़ा घर जहाँ फ़सल, अनाज, भूसा और औज़ार रखे जाते हैं
definition: a large farm building with a high roof, used for storing hay, grain and machinery or for sheltering animals
example: After the harvest, the whole village gathered in the barn to sort the grain.

hindi: टोकरी — बेंत, बाँस या तार से बुना हुआ खुला बर्तन जिसमें सामान रखकर ले जाया जाता है
definition: a container woven from cane, straw or wire, usually with a handle, used for carrying or storing fruit, bread, clothes and other things
example: She filled the basket with ripe mangoes and carried it home from the market.

hindi: समुद्र तट — समुद्र या झील के किनारे रेत या छोटे पत्थरों से भरी जगह
definition: a strip of sand or small stones beside the sea or a lake, where people walk, swim and play
example: We spent the whole afternoon on the beach, building a sandcastle that the tide quickly washed away.

hindi: पलंग — लकड़ी या लोहे का बना वह फ़र्नीचर जिस पर गद्दा बिछाकर लोग सोते हैं
definition: a large piece of furniture with a soft mattress, pillows and blankets, where people lie down to sleep at night
example: The cat jumped onto the bed and refused to move for the whole afternoon.

hindi: मधुमक्खी — एक उड़ने वाला कीड़ा जो फूलों से रस इकट्ठा करके शहद बनाता है
definition: a small flying insect with a striped yellow and black body that collects nectar from flowers and makes honey
example: The bee settled on a sunflower and hummed happily while it worked.

hindi: घंटी — धातु की बनी, बजाने पर तेज़ आवाज़ देने वाली कटोरी जैसी चीज़
definition: a hollow metal object shaped like a cup, which makes a clear ringing sound when it is struck or shaken
example: When the school bell rings, the whole corridor fills with happy noise.

hindi: बेल्ट — कमर पर बाँधी जाने वाली चमड़े या कपड़े की पट्टी, जिससे पैंट कसी रहती है
definition: a long, narrow strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist to hold up trousers, usually fastened with a metal buckle
example: Grandfather pulled his belt one notch tighter after a very large lunch.

hindi: साइकिल — दो पहियों वाली सवारी जिसे पैडल मारकर चलाया जाता है
definition: a vehicle with two wheels, a seat and handlebars, which you ride by pushing pedals with your feet
example: On Sunday mornings we ride our bicycles to the park and back.

hindi: कंबल — ऊन या मोटे कपड़े की बनी बड़ी चादर जो सर्दी में शरीर को गर्म रखने के लिए ओढ़ी जाती है
definition: a large, thick piece of soft cloth, usually made of wool or fleece, that you spread over yourself to keep warm in bed
example: On cold winter nights, nothing feels better than a warm blanket and a hot cup of tea.

hindi: नाव — पानी पर तैरने वाली छोटी सवारी जिसे चप्पू, पाल या इंजन से चलाते हैं
definition: a small vessel that floats and carries people or goods across water, moved by oars, sails or an engine
example: The little boat rocked gently as we drifted across the quiet lake.

hindi: किताब — जिल्द के भीतर जुड़े छपे पन्नों का वह संग्रह जिसे हम पढ़ते हैं
definition: a set of printed pages joined together inside a cover, which people read for stories, facts or study
example: She curled up on the sofa with a good book and a cup of tea.

hindi: बूट — टखने या घुटने तक पैर को ढकने वाला मज़बूत जूता
definition: a strong shoe that covers the foot and ankle, and sometimes the leg up to the knee, worn in rain, mud or snow
example: She jumped into every puddle on the way home, and one boot filled with water.

hindi: बोतल — काँच या प्लास्टिक का लंबी गर्दन वाला बर्तन जिसमें पानी, दूध या कोई और तरल पदार्थ भरकर रखा जाता है
definition: a glass or plastic container with a narrow neck and a cap or cork, used for keeping water, milk or other liquids
example: He always carries a bottle of cold water in his bag during summer.

hindi: कटोरा — खाने-पीने की चीज़ें रखने के लिए गहरा और गोल बर्तन
definition: a deep, round dish with a wide opening, used for serving or eating soup, rice, cereal and other food
example: Grandma served the hot dal in a big steel bowl, and everyone wanted seconds.

hindi: ब्रेड — आटे या मैदे से सेंककर बनाई गई नरम चीज़, जिसके स्लाइस काटकर खाए जाते हैं
definition: a baked food made from flour, water and yeast, usually cut into slices and eaten with butter or jam
example: He toasted two slices of bread and spread butter on them while the tea brewed.

hindi: पुल — नदी, सड़क या घाटी के ऊपर बना ढाँचा जिससे लोग और गाड़ियाँ दूसरी ओर पहुँचते हैं
definition: a structure built over a river, road or valley so that people and vehicles can cross from one side to the other
example: The old bridge shakes a little whenever a heavy truck rumbles across it.

hindi: ब्रोकली — छोटे पेड़ जैसी बनावट वाली हरी सब्ज़ी, जिसमें मोटे डंठल पर फूलों का गुच्छा होता है
definition: a green vegetable shaped like a small tree, with a thick stalk and a tight head of tiny flower buds
example: The little boy said the broccoli looked like a forest and ate it bravely.

hindi: झाड़ू — लंबी डंडी और तिनकों से बनी चीज़ जिससे फ़र्श की धूल और कचरा साफ़ किया जाता है
definition: a cleaning tool with a long handle and a bunch of stiff bristles or grass at one end, used for sweeping floors
example: Every morning she takes the broom and sweeps the dust out of the front door.

hindi: ब्रश — हत्थे के सिरे पर रेशों या बालों का गुच्छा लगा औज़ार, जिससे रंग लगाते या सफ़ाई करते हैं
definition: a tool with a handle and a bunch of bristles at one end, used for painting, cleaning or tidying hair
example: He dipped the brush in blue paint and began colouring the sky.

hindi: बाल्टी — धातु या प्लास्टिक का गोल खुला बर्तन जिसमें हैंडल लगा होता है और जिसमें पानी भरकर ले जाया जाता है
definition: a round, open container made of plastic or metal with a handle over the top, used for carrying water
example: The children filled the bucket at the tap and carried it carefully to the garden.

hindi: बस — सड़क पर चलने वाली बड़ी गाड़ी जिसमें बहुत-से यात्री एक साथ सफ़र करते हैं
definition: a large road vehicle with many seats that carries passengers along a fixed route and stops at set places
example: I missed the bus by a minute, so I enjoyed a slow walk instead.

hindi: तितली — रंग-बिरंगे पंखों वाला एक सुंदर कीड़ा जो फूलों पर मँडराता है
definition: an insect with four large, colourful wings that flutters from flower to flower and starts life as a caterpillar
example: A yellow butterfly landed on my notebook, as if it wanted to read too.

hindi: बटन — कपड़े को बंद करने के लिए लगा हुआ छोटा गोल टुकड़ा
definition: a small, round, flat piece sewn onto clothes, pushed through a hole or loop to fasten two edges together
example: One button on his shirt came loose, so he kept his jacket closed all day.

hindi: पत्तागोभी — हरी या बैंगनी पत्तियों की कसी हुई परतों से बनी गोल सब्ज़ी
definition: a large round vegetable made of tightly packed green or purple leaves, eaten raw in salads or cooked
example: Mother chopped the cabbage finely and tossed it into the hot, sizzling pan.

hindi: नागफनी — काँटों से भरा रेगिस्तानी पौधा जो अपने मोटे तने में पानी जमा रखता है
definition: a thick, spiny desert plant that stores water in its fleshy green stem and sometimes bears bright flowers
example: Be careful with that cactus; its tiny spines are harder to spot than to remove.

hindi: केक — आटे, चीनी और मक्खन से सेंका हुआ नरम मीठा पकवान, जो अक्सर जन्मदिन पर काटा जाता है
definition: a soft sweet baked food made from flour, sugar and butter, often decorated with icing and eaten at birthdays
example: We sang loudly while she blew out the candles on the cake.

hindi: कैलकुलेटर — जोड़, घटाव, गुणा और भाग झटपट करने वाली छोटी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक मशीन
definition: a small electronic device with number buttons and a screen that quickly adds, subtracts, multiplies and divides numbers
example: I always reach for the calculator when the shop bill gets complicated.

hindi: ऊँट — पीठ पर कूबड़ वाला लंबा जानवर जो रेगिस्तान में सवारी और बोझ ढोने के काम आता है
definition: a tall desert animal with a long neck and one or two humps on its back, used for carrying people and loads
example: The camel strolled across the sand as calmly as if it owned the desert.

hindi: कैमरा — फ़ोटो और वीडियो खींचने वाला यंत्र
definition: a device with a lens that captures photographs or videos, usually held in the hands or fixed on a stand
example: Please smile at the camera, everyone, and hold still for a moment.

hindi: मोमबत्ती — मोम की बनी बत्ती वाली छड़ जो जलाने पर रोशनी देती है
definition: a stick of wax with a string wick in the middle, which gives a soft, flickering light when you burn it
example: When the power went out, we lit a candle and told stories until dinner.

hindi: डोंगी — चप्पू से चलाई जाने वाली पतली और हल्की छोटी नाव
definition: a light, narrow boat pointed at both ends, which a person paddles while sitting or kneeling facing forward
example: We paddled the canoe slowly along the river and watched the herons.

hindi: टोपी — सिर पर पहना जाने वाला नरम, गोल कपड़ा जिसके आगे छज्जा निकला होता है
definition: a soft, close-fitting hat with a stiff curved front part called a peak, worn to shade the eyes
example: He wore his cap backwards and still managed to look very serious.

hindi: कार — इंजन से चलने वाली चार पहियों की गाड़ी जिसमें कुछ लोग बैठकर सफ़र करते हैं
definition: a road vehicle with four wheels and an engine, designed to carry a driver and a few passengers
example: Our old car rattles a little, but it always gets us home.

hindi: गाजर — लंबी, नुकीली और नारंगी रंग की जड़ वाली सब्ज़ी जो मिट्टी के नीचे उगती है
definition: a long pointed orange root vegetable that grows underground and tastes sweet and crunchy when eaten raw
example: The rabbit nibbled the carrot down to a tiny stub.

hindi: किला — मोटी पत्थर की दीवारों और बुर्जों वाली बड़ी पुरानी इमारत जो राजा की रक्षा के लिए बनी थी
definition: a large old building with thick stone walls and towers, built long ago to protect a king or lord
example: From the top of the castle you can see the entire valley and the winding river.

hindi: बिल्ली — एक छोटा पालतू जानवर जिसके नरम रोएँ, लंबी मूँछें और तेज़ पंजे होते हैं
definition: a small furry pet with whiskers, sharp claws and pointed ears that purrs when happy and chases mice
example: Our cat sleeps all afternoon in the one patch of sunlight on the sofa.

hindi: गुफ़ा — पहाड़ या चट्टान के अंदर बनी बड़ी प्राकृतिक खोखली जगह
definition: a large natural hollow space under the ground or inside a hill or cliff, often dark and cool
example: The bats slept quietly in the cave until our torch woke them up.

hindi: ज़ंजीर — धातु की कड़ियों को एक-दूसरे में फँसाकर बनी मज़बूत लंबी लड़ी
definition: a row of metal rings linked together in a line, used to pull, hold, fasten or decorate things
example: The old gate was fastened shut with a heavy iron chain.

hindi: कुर्सी — पीठ टिकाने की जगह और चार पैरों वाली वह सीट जिस पर एक व्यक्ति बैठता है
definition: a seat for one person, with a back and usually four legs, often made of wood, metal or plastic
example: Please pull up a chair and sit with us while the tea is still hot.

hindi: चीज़ — दूध से बना पीला या सफ़ेद ठोस खाना, जिसे काटकर या कद्दूकस करके खाया जाता है
definition: a solid food made from milk, usually yellow or white, that can be sliced, melted or grated
example: A small mouse crept toward the cheese, hoping nobody in the house was awake.

hindi: चेरी — एक छोटा, गोल, चमकदार लाल फल जिसमें लंबी डंडी और अंदर कड़ी गुठली होती है
definition: a small round shiny red fruit with a long thin stalk and a hard stone inside
example: She placed a bright cherry on top of the ice cream and smiled.

hindi: शतरंज की बिसात — चौंसठ काले-सफ़ेद खानों वाला चौकोर तख़्ता
definition: a square board marked with 64 alternating light and dark squares, on which the game of chess is played
example: Uncle laid out the chessboard and promised a quick game that lasted all afternoon.

hindi: मिर्च — तीखा स्वाद देने वाली लंबी, पतली हरी या लाल फली
definition: a small thin green or red pod that tastes very hot and is used to add spice to food
example: One bite of the green chili made his eyes water and his ears burn.

hindi: घड़ी — दीवार या मेज़ पर रखा जाने वाला यंत्र जो समय बताता है
definition: a device with a round face and moving hands that shows the time, usually hung on a wall or kept on a table
example: The clock on the wall ticked loudly in the quiet room.

hindi: बादल — आसमान में तैरता पानी की नन्हीं बूँदों से बना सफ़ेद या स्लेटी गुच्छा जिससे बारिश होती है
definition: a white or grey mass of tiny water drops floating high in the sky, from which rain often falls
example: A single dark cloud drifted over the cricket ground, and everyone looked for their umbrellas.

hindi: कोट — सर्दी से बचाने वाला, लंबी बाँहों का गर्म ऊपरी कपड़ा
definition: a long, warm piece of clothing with sleeves, worn over other clothes outdoors to keep out the cold
example: It was so cold that she buttoned her coat up to her chin.

hindi: नारियल — भूरे रेशेदार खोल वाला बड़ा गोल फल, जिसके अंदर सफ़ेद गूदा और मीठा पानी होता है
definition: a large round fruit with a hard hairy brown shell, white flesh inside and sweet watery juice in the middle
example: The vendor chopped the top off the coconut and handed me a straw.

hindi: कॉफ़ी — भुने हुए बीजों को पीसकर बनाया गया गहरे भूरे रंग का गरम और कड़वा पेय
definition: a hot dark brown drink made from roasted ground beans, which many people enjoy in the morning
example: Grandfather held his warm coffee with both hands and watched the rain fall.

hindi: सिक्का — धातु का छोटा, गोल और चपटा टुकड़ा जो पैसे के रूप में चलता है
definition: a small, round, flat piece of metal stamped with a design and used as money
example: He found a shiny coin under the sofa cushion and grinned.

hindi: कंघी — प्लास्टिक या लकड़ी की दाँतेदार पट्टी जिससे बाल सुलझाए और सँवारे जाते हैं
definition: a flat strip of plastic, wood or metal with a row of thin teeth, used to tidy and straighten your hair
example: He ran a comb through his messy hair and was ready for school.

hindi: कम्पास — दिशा बताने वाला यंत्र जिसकी चुंबकीय सुई हमेशा उत्तर की ओर रहती है
definition: an instrument with a magnetic needle that always points north, helping travellers find their direction
example: Without a compass, the hikers could not tell which way was north.

hindi: मक्का — हरे छिलके में लिपटा, पीले दानों से भरा भुट्टा, जिसे भूनकर या उबालकर खाया जाता है
definition: a tall crop whose long green-wrapped ear is packed with rows of sweet yellow grains, eaten boiled or roasted
example: On rainy evenings we roast corn over the coals and add lemon and salt.

hindi: गाय — खेतों में पाला जाने वाला बड़ा जानवर जो दूध देता है
definition: a large farm animal with four legs, a long tail and often black and white patches, kept for its milk
example: Every morning the cow waits quietly at the gate to be milked.

hindi: केकड़ा — कठोर खोल और दो बड़े पंजों वाला जीव जो समुद्र के किनारे आड़ा चलता है
definition: a sea creature with a hard flat shell, eight legs and two large claws that walks sideways on the beach
example: A small crab scuttled sideways into a rock pool as we walked past.

hindi: क्रेयॉन — मोम का रंगीन डंडा जिससे बच्चे चित्र बनाते और रंग भरते हैं
definition: a short coloured stick of wax that children use to draw pictures and colour in shapes on paper
example: My little sister coloured the whole sun with one orange crayon.

hindi: मगरमच्छ — पानी में रहने वाला बड़ा, खुरदरी खाल और नुकीले दाँतों वाला सरीसृप
definition: a large reptile with rough green or brown skin, a long snout and many sharp teeth, living in rivers and lakes
example: The crocodile lay so still in the river that it looked like a log.

hindi: खीरा — हरे छिलके वाली लंबी, ठंडी और पानी से भरी सब्ज़ी जिसे अक्सर कच्चा खाया जाता है
definition: a long green vegetable with crisp, watery flesh that is often sliced and eaten raw in salads
example: On hot afternoons, a cool slice of cucumber with salt tastes like a small holiday.

hindi: कप — चाय, कॉफ़ी या दूध पीने के लिए छोटा गोल बर्तन जिसमें एक हैंडल होता है
definition: a small, round container, often with a handle, from which you drink hot drinks such as tea and coffee
example: She wrapped both hands around the cup and enjoyed the warm steam rising from her tea.

hindi: हिरन — पतले पैरों वाला तेज़ दौड़ने वाला जंगली जानवर, जिसके नर के सिर पर शाखादार सींग होते हैं
definition: a graceful wild animal with slender legs and a brown coat, the males of which grow branching antlers
example: A deer stepped out of the trees, looked at us, and quietly disappeared.

hindi: रेगिस्तान — रेत से भरा विशाल सूखा इलाक़ा जहाँ बारिश बहुत कम होती है और पौधे कम उगते हैं
definition: a huge dry area of sand or rock where it hardly ever rains and very few plants or animals can live
example: Camels can walk across the desert for days without needing a single drink of water.

hindi: पासा — खेलों में फेंका जाने वाला, बिंदियों वाला छोटा घनाकार टुकड़ा
definition: small cubes with one to six dots on each side, thrown in board games to show a number by chance
example: I shook the dice twice, hoping for a six, and got a one both times.

hindi: कुत्ता — एक वफ़ादार पालतू जानवर जो भौंकता है और घर की रखवाली करता है
definition: a loyal four-legged pet with a wet nose and a wagging tail that barks and is often trained to guard or play
example: My dog wags his whole body when I come home from school.

hindi: गुड़िया — बच्चों के खेलने के लिए बनी, इंसान जैसी दिखने वाली छोटी मूरत
definition: a small toy figure shaped like a person, usually a girl or baby, which children hold and play with
example: My little sister gives her doll a bath and a bedtime story every night.

hindi: डॉल्फ़िन — समुद्र में रहने वाला समझदार और खिलंदड़ा स्तनधारी जीव जो पानी से ऊपर कूदता है
definition: a smart, friendly sea mammal with a smooth grey body and a pointed snout that leaps high above the waves
example: A dolphin leapt out of the water, and all the children cheered.

hindi: गधा — लंबे कानों वाला मज़बूत जानवर जो बोझ ढोने के काम आता है
definition: a sturdy grey or brown animal like a small horse, with long ears, that carries heavy loads and brays loudly
example: The donkey plodded up the hill with two heavy sacks on its back.

hindi: दरवाज़ा — लकड़ी या धातु का वह पल्ला जो घर या कमरे के रास्ते को खोलता और बंद करता है
definition: a flat panel of wood, metal or glass that swings or slides to open and close the entrance to a room or building
example: Someone knocked on the door just as we sat down to eat lunch.

hindi: डोनट — बीच में छेद वाली, तली हुई गोल मीठी चीज़ जिस पर अक्सर चॉकलेट या चीनी की परत होती है
definition: a soft, sweet, fried ring of pastry with a hole in the middle, often covered in icing or sugar
example: He ate the pink doughnut in four bites and licked the sugar off his fingers.

hindi: दराज़ — मेज़ या अलमारी में लगा बाहर खींचकर खुलने वाला डिब्बेनुमा खाना जिसमें सामान रखा जाता है
definition: a box-shaped compartment in a desk or cupboard that you pull out to put things in or take them out
example: My socks were all tangled up in the drawer, so I wore mismatched ones.

hindi: ड्रेस — लड़कियों या औरतों का एक ही टुकड़े का ऊपर से नीचे तक का पहनावा
definition: a piece of women's or girls' clothing that covers the top of the body and hangs down over the legs in one piece
example: Her yellow dress spun out like a bright flower when she twirled.

hindi: ढोल — खाल मढ़ा हुआ बाजा, जिसे डंडियों या हाथ से पीटकर बजाते हैं
definition: a musical instrument made of a hollow cylinder with tight skin stretched across the top, played by hitting it with sticks or hands
example: The little boy beat the drum so loudly that the pigeons flew off the roof.

hindi: बत्तख — चपटी चोंच वाला पक्षी जो तालाब या झील के पानी में तैरता है
definition: a water bird with a flat beak and webbed feet that swims on ponds and makes a loud quacking sound
example: The duck paddled across the pond with five fluffy ducklings following in a neat line.

hindi: गरुड़ — बहुत ऊँचा उड़ने वाला शक्तिशाली शिकारी पक्षी जिसकी नज़र बहुत तेज़ होती है
definition: a large, powerful bird of prey with broad wings, a hooked beak and very sharp eyesight, which soars high in the sky
example: An eagle circled slowly above the valley, watching everything below with sharp eyes.

hindi: अंडा — मुर्गी का अंडाकार, पतले कड़े खोल वाला खाने का सामान, जिसके अंदर पीली जर्दी और सफ़ेदी होती है
definition: an oval food with a thin hard shell, laid by hens, holding a yellow yolk surrounded by white
example: Grandmother tapped the egg on the edge of the bowl and it cracked neatly.

hindi: बैंगन — चमकदार गहरे बैंगनी रंग की सब्ज़ी, जिसके सिरे पर हरी टोपी जैसा डंठल होता है
definition: a glossy dark purple vegetable with a green cap and soft, pale flesh that is usually cooked in curries or roasted
example: She roasted the eggplant over the flame until its skin turned black and smoky.

hindi: हाथी — लंबी सूँड़, बड़े कानों और मोटे पैरों वाला धरती का सबसे बड़ा जानवर
definition: the largest land animal, with thick grey skin, big flapping ears, two tusks and a long trunk for drinking and grasping
example: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk and looked very pleased.

hindi: लिफ़ाफ़ा — चिट्ठी या कार्ड रखकर बंद करने वाला काग़ज़ का आयताकार खोल
definition: a flat paper cover with a sealable flap, used for putting a letter or card inside before posting it
example: She sealed the envelope, stuck on a stamp and walked to the postbox.

hindi: आँख — चेहरे पर मौजूद गोल अंग जिससे हम देखते हैं
definition: one of the two round organs in the face, with a coloured ring and dark centre, that people use to see
example: She closed one eye and carefully threaded the needle on her first try.

hindi: पंख — चिड़िया के शरीर पर उगा हलका, मुलायम और रेशेदार टुकड़ा जो उसे गर्म रखता है
definition: one of the light, soft, fringed growths that cover a bird's body and help it fly and stay warm
example: She tucked a white feather into her hat and walked off feeling rather elegant.

hindi: झंडा — किसी देश या संस्था की पहचान दिखाने वाला रंगीन कपड़े का टुकड़ा जो डंडे पर फहराया जाता है
definition: a piece of cloth in particular colours and patterns, flown from a pole to represent a country or group
example: The children waved a small flag as the parade marched past.

hindi: फ़्लेमिंगो — गुलाबी पंखों और बहुत लंबी टाँगों वाला पक्षी जो अक्सर एक पैर पर खड़ा रहता है
definition: a tall pink water bird with very long thin legs and a long curved neck that often stands on one leg
example: The flamingo stood on one leg in the shallow lake, perfectly balanced and perfectly pink.

hindi: बाँसुरी — फूँक मारकर बजाया जाने वाला, छेदों वाला लंबा बाजा
definition: a long, thin musical pipe with finger holes, played by blowing across a hole near one end
example: The soft music of a flute drifted across the fields as the sun went down.

hindi: पैर — टाँग के नीचे का वह हिस्सा जिस पर हम खड़े होते और चलते हैं, जिसमें एड़ी और पाँच उँगलियाँ होती हैं
definition: the part at the bottom of the leg, with a heel and five toes, that you stand and walk on
example: He stepped in a puddle with his left foot and squelched all the way home.

hindi: जंगल — बहुत सारे पेड़ों और झाड़ियों से घिरा बड़ा इलाक़ा जहाँ कई जानवर रहते हैं
definition: a large area thickly covered with trees and plants, where many wild animals live
example: The path through the forest was so quiet that we could hear every bird.

hindi: काँटा — खाना उठाकर खाने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला नुकीले दाँतों वाला छोटा बर्तन
definition: a small tool with a handle and two or more pointed prongs, used for picking up food and eating it
example: He twirled the spaghetti around his fork and hoped no sauce would reach his shirt.

hindi: फ़व्वारा — पानी को ऊपर उछालने वाला सजावटी ढाँचा जो अकसर बाग़ या चौक में लगा होता है
definition: a structure that shoots a jet of water into the air, usually in a park, garden or town square
example: The children threw coins into the fountain and made wishes they refused to share.

hindi: लोमड़ी — लाल-भूरे रोएँ और झबरीली पूँछ वाला चालाक जंगली जानवर
definition: a wild animal like a small dog, with reddish-brown fur, pointed ears, a narrow face and a thick bushy tail
example: The fox slipped through the hedge, its bushy tail disappearing last.

hindi: मेंढक — हरी चिकनी त्वचा और लंबी पिछली टाँगों वाला जीव जो बारिश में टर्र-टर्र करता है
definition: a small green animal with smooth wet skin and strong back legs for jumping, which lives near water and croaks
example: A frog jumped onto the lily leaf, and the whole pond went quiet.

hindi: लहसुन — सफ़ेद पतले छिलके में लिपटी कलियों वाला तेज़ गंध का कंद जो खाने में स्वाद के लिए डाला जाता है
definition: a small round bulb made of separate white cloves in papery skin, with a strong smell and taste used in cooking
example: The smell of garlic frying in hot oil drifted from the kitchen to the street.

hindi: जिराफ़ — बहुत लंबी गर्दन और टाँगों वाला धब्बेदार जानवर जो पेड़ों की ऊँची पत्तियाँ खाता है
definition: the tallest animal in the world, with a very long neck, long legs and a yellow coat covered in brown patches
example: The giraffe bent its long neck down to drink, looking slightly embarrassed.

hindi: ग्लोब — पृथ्वी का गोल नमूना जिस पर देश और समुद्र दिखाए गए होते हैं
definition: a round model of the Earth, usually on a stand, showing countries and oceans in miniature
example: Grandpa spun the globe and pointed to a faraway island.

hindi: दस्ताना — हाथ और उँगलियों को ठंड या चोट से बचाने वाला पहनावा
definition: a covering for the hand with separate parts for the thumb and each finger, worn for warmth or protection
example: He lost one glove on the bus and kept the other in his pocket.

hindi: बकरी — सींगों और छोटी दाढ़ी वाला पालतू जानवर जो दूध देता है और पहाड़ों पर आसानी से चढ़ जाता है
definition: a hardy farm animal with horns, a short tail and a small beard, kept for milk and good at climbing rocks
example: The goat climbed onto the roof of the shed to get a better view.

hindi: अंगूर — गुच्छों में लगने वाला छोटा, गोल, रसीला फल जो हरा, लाल या काला होता है
definition: a small round juicy fruit that grows in bunches on a vine and may be green, red or purple
example: Each grape was so sweet that the bunch disappeared before lunch.

hindi: गिटार — तारों वाला, उँगलियों से छेड़कर बजाया जाने वाला लकड़ी का बाजा
definition: a musical instrument with a wooden body, a long neck and six strings, played by plucking or strumming
example: He tuned his guitar slowly, and everyone around the campfire began to hum.

hindi: हथौड़ा — कील ठोकने या चीज़ें तोड़ने के लिए भारी सिर और हत्थे वाला औज़ार
definition: a tool with a heavy metal head on a handle, used for hitting nails into wood and breaking things apart
example: Dad tapped the nail gently with the hammer and hung the picture.

hindi: हाथ — कलाई के आगे का वह अंग जिसमें हथेली और उँगलियाँ होती हैं और जिससे हम चीज़ें पकड़ते हैं
definition: the part of the body at the end of the arm, with a palm, four fingers and a thumb, used for holding things
example: He raised his hand politely, but the teacher was busy writing on the board.

hindi: हैंगर — कपड़े टाँगने के लिए बना हुक वाला तार, लकड़ी या प्लास्टिक का ढाँचा
definition: a curved piece of wire, wood or plastic with a hook at the top, used for hanging clothes in a wardrobe
example: She hung the wet shirt on a hanger and left it near the window to dry.

hindi: हार्प — बड़े तिकोने ढाँचे पर कसे तारों वाला बाजा, जिसे उँगलियों से बजाते हैं
definition: a large musical instrument with many strings stretched on a tall triangular frame, played by plucking with the fingers
example: The harp stood in the corner of the hall, its golden strings glowing in the light.

hindi: हैट — सिर पर पहनी जाने वाली, चारों ओर किनारी वाली बड़ी टोपी
definition: a covering for the head, often with a brim around the edge, worn for warmth, for shade or as part of an outfit
example: A strong gust of wind lifted his hat and sent it rolling down the lane.

hindi: झाऊ चूहा — पीठ पर नुकीले काँटों वाला छोटा जानवर जो ख़तरा देखकर गेंद की तरह सिकुड़ जाता है
definition: a small brown animal covered in sharp spines on its back that curls into a tight ball when frightened
example: The hedgehog rolled into a ball when the garden gate creaked open.

hindi: हेलीकॉप्टर — ऊपर लगे घूमते पंखों से सीधा उड़ने और उतरने वाला विमान
definition: an aircraft with large spinning blades on top that lets it lift straight up, hover and land in small spaces
example: The helicopter hovered over the field, and the grass bent in waves.

hindi: शहद — मधुमक्खियों द्वारा फूलों के रस से बनाया गया गाढ़ा, सुनहरा और मीठा तरल
definition: a thick sweet golden liquid made by bees from flower nectar, often spread on bread or stirred into tea
example: A spoonful of honey slid slowly off the spoon and onto the warm toast.

hindi: घोड़ा — चार पैरों वाला तेज़ दौड़ने वाला जानवर जिस पर लोग सवारी करते हैं
definition: a large strong animal with a long mane and tail and four hooves, ridden by people and used to pull carts
example: The horse trotted around the field while the children waved from the fence.

hindi: आइसबर्ग — समुद्र में तैरती बर्फ़ की विशाल चट्टान जिसका ज़्यादातर हिस्सा पानी के नीचे छिपा रहता है
definition: a huge block of ice floating in the sea, with most of it hidden below the water
example: Only the tip of the iceberg is visible; the rest hides quietly beneath the waves.

hindi: हिमलंब — बर्फ़ की लंबी नुकीली छड़ जो टपकता पानी जमने से छत या डाल से लटकती है
definition: a long, pointed piece of ice that hangs down from a roof or branch when dripping water freezes
example: A long icicle hung from the roof and dripped slowly onto the doorstep.

hindi: इग्लू — बर्फ़ की सख़्त सिल्लियों से बना गुंबद जैसा गोल घर जिसमें बहुत ठंडे इलाक़ों के लोग रहते हैं
definition: a round house shaped like a dome, built from blocks of hard snow by people living in the Arctic
example: Inside the igloo it was surprisingly warm, and we drank hot tea with our gloves on.

hindi: द्वीप — चारों ओर से पानी से घिरा ज़मीन का छोटा या बड़ा टुकड़ा
definition: a piece of land completely surrounded by water, either in the sea, in a lake or in a river
example: We reached the island by a small boat and had the whole beach to ourselves.

hindi: जैकेट — कमर तक आने वाला, आगे से बंद होने वाला हल्का गर्म ऊपरी कपड़ा
definition: a short coat reaching the waist or hips, usually with a zip or buttons down the front and long sleeves
example: On chilly mornings she zips her jacket right up to her nose.

hindi: मर्तबान — चौड़े मुँह वाला काँच या चीनी मिट्टी का बर्तन जिसमें अचार, जैम या मसाले भरकर रखे जाते हैं
definition: a round container made of glass or clay with a wide mouth and a lid, used for storing pickles, jam or spices
example: Mum kept a jar of mango pickle on the top shelf, safe from hungry little hands.

hindi: जेलीफ़िश — समुद्र में तैरने वाला छतरी जैसे आकार का नरम पारदर्शी जीव जिसके लटकते हुए लंबे धागे जैसे अंग होते हैं
definition: a soft, see-through sea creature shaped like an umbrella, with long trailing tentacles that can sting
example: We watched a jellyfish drift past the glass, glowing softly like a lamp.

hindi: केतली — चाय या पानी उबालने के लिए बना नली और हैंडल वाला ढक्कनदार बर्तन
definition: a metal or plastic pot with a lid, a spout and a handle, used for boiling water for tea or coffee
example: The kettle began to whistle, so I hurried to the kitchen to make the tea.

hindi: चाबी — धातु की छोटी छड़ जिससे ताला खोला या बंद किया जाता है
definition: a small piece of metal with a shaped end, which you put in a lock and turn to open or close it
example: I searched my bag for ten minutes before finding the key at the very bottom.

hindi: पतंग — डोर के सहारे हवा में उड़ाया जाने वाला काग़ज़ का खिलौना
definition: a light toy made of paper or cloth on a frame, flown in the wind on a long string
example: My brother's kite climbed higher and higher until it was just a tiny dot.

hindi: चाकू — तेज़ धार वाला औज़ार जिससे फल, सब्ज़ियाँ और दूसरी चीज़ें काटी जाती हैं
definition: a tool with a sharp metal blade fixed to a handle, used for cutting vegetables, fruit, bread and other food
example: Please be careful with the knife when you slice the onions for dinner.

hindi: सीढ़ी — लकड़ी, धातु या बाँस की बनी डंडियों वाली चीज़ जिस पर चढ़कर ऊँची जगह पहुँचा जाता है
definition: a tall frame of wood or metal with two long sides joined by flat steps, which you climb to reach high places
example: Dad leaned the ladder against the wall and climbed up to fix the light.

hindi: लेडीबर्ड — लाल पंखों पर काली बिंदियों वाला छोटा गोल कीड़ा
definition: a tiny round beetle with a shiny red back dotted with black spots, often found on garden leaves
example: A ladybird crawled up my finger and then opened its wings and flew away.

hindi: लैंप — बिजली, तेल या गैस से जलने वाला उपकरण जो कमरे में रोशनी करता है
definition: a device that gives light, usually with a bulb inside a shade, placed on a table or floor
example: He switched on the lamp beside his bed and read for another hour.

hindi: लालटेन — काँच या काग़ज़ के खोल में बंद रोशनी जिसे हाथ में लेकर चलते या टाँग देते हैं
definition: a portable light with a flame or bulb inside a glass or paper case, carried or hung up at night
example: Grandma hung a glowing lantern outside the door for the festival.

hindi: पत्ता — पेड़ या पौधे का चपटा, अकसर हरा हिस्सा जो डंठल से जुड़ा रहता है
definition: a flat, usually green part of a plant that grows from a stem or branch and makes food from sunlight
example: A single golden leaf floated down and landed right on my open notebook.

hindi: नींबू — पीले छिलके वाला अंडाकार, खट्टा और रसीला फल, जिसका रस शरबत और खाने में डाला जाता है
definition: an oval yellow fruit with sour juice, often squeezed into drinks or over food to add a sharp taste
example: She squeezed half a lemon into the water and made a face at the first sip.

hindi: प्रकाश स्तंभ — समुद्र किनारे बनी ऊँची मीनार जिसकी तेज़ रोशनी जहाज़ों को रास्ता दिखाती है
definition: a tall tower by the sea with a powerful light at the top that guides ships and warns them of danger
example: The keeper climbed every step of the lighthouse to switch on the lamp before dusk.

hindi: बिजली — तूफ़ान में बादलों से चमकने वाली तेज़ रोशनी की टेढ़ी रेखा, जिसके बाद गड़गड़ाहट सुनाई देती है
definition: a sudden bright flash of light in the sky during a storm, caused by electricity moving between clouds or to the ground
example: We counted the seconds between the lightning and the thunder to guess how far the storm was.

hindi: शेर — सुनहरे रंग का बड़ा जंगली जानवर जिसके नर की गर्दन पर घनी अयाल होती है
definition: a large golden-brown wild cat that lives in groups and whose male has a thick mane around its head and neck
example: The lion yawned so widely that the children giggled behind the glass.

hindi: छिपकली — लंबी पूँछ और चार छोटे पैरों वाला रेंगने वाला जीव जो दीवारों पर चलता है
definition: a small reptile with a long tail, four short legs and dry scaly skin that runs quickly over walls and rocks
example: A lizard froze on the warm wall, then darted into a crack.

hindi: कमल — तालाब में खिलने वाला बड़ा गुलाबी या सफ़ेद फूल, जो भारत का राष्ट्रीय फूल है
definition: a large pink or white flower that grows in still ponds, with round flat leaves floating on the water
example: A pink lotus opened at dawn, and the whole pond seemed to smile.

hindi: आम — पीले-हरे या लाल छिलके वाला बड़ा, मीठा और रसीला फल जिसके अंदर एक बड़ी गुठली होती है
definition: a large oval tropical fruit with smooth green, yellow or red skin, sweet orange flesh and one big stone
example: In summer, the whole family sits on the porch and shares one juicy mango.

hindi: नक्शा — किसी इलाक़े, शहर या देश की सड़कों, नदियों और सीमाओं को दिखाने वाला चित्र
definition: a flat drawing of a town, country or the world, showing places, roads, rivers and borders
example: We unfolded the map on the bonnet and searched for the nearest tea stall.

hindi: मेडल — जीत या सम्मान में दिया जाने वाला गोल, चमकता धातु का तमग़ा
definition: a flat piece of metal, often round and hung on a ribbon, given as a prize or an honour
example: He won a medal in the race and slept with it around his neck.

hindi: माइक्रोस्कोप — बहुत छोटी चीज़ों को कई गुना बड़ा करके दिखाने वाला यंत्र
definition: an instrument with lenses that makes tiny things, too small to see with the eye, look much larger
example: Under the microscope, a single drop of pond water was full of life.

hindi: दूध — गाय या भैंस से मिलने वाला सफ़ेद पौष्टिक तरल पेय
definition: a white liquid that cows and other animals produce to feed their young, which people also drink and use in cooking
example: The cat sat patiently by the bowl, waiting for someone to pour some milk.

hindi: आईना — चमकदार काँच की सतह जिसमें देखने पर अपनी छवि दिखाई देती है
definition: a smooth piece of glass that reflects light, so you can see your own face and body when you look into it
example: She smiled at herself in the mirror and straightened her new school tie.

hindi: बंदर — लंबी पूँछ वाला चुलबुला जानवर जो पेड़ों पर कूदता-फाँदता है और केले खाता है
definition: a clever, playful animal covered in fur, with a long tail and hands that grip, which swings through trees
example: The monkey grabbed my banana, peeled it neatly and looked very proud of itself.

hindi: चाँद — रात को आसमान में चमकने वाला गोल पिंड जो पृथ्वी के चारों ओर घूमता है
definition: the large round object that shines in the night sky and travels around the earth once every month
example: The full moon was so bright that we walked home without using a torch.

hindi: मोटरसाइकिल — इंजन से चलने वाली दो पहियों की तेज़ सवारी
definition: a two-wheeled road vehicle with a powerful engine, a seat and handlebars, ridden by one or two people
example: The motorcycle roared down the lane, and the neighbourhood dogs barked back.

hindi: पहाड़ — ज़मीन से बहुत ऊँचा उठा विशाल चट्टानी भाग जिसकी चोटी पर अकसर बर्फ़ जमी रहती है
definition: a very high, steep piece of land rising far above the ground around it, often with snow on its top
example: It took us two days to climb the mountain, and the view was worth every step.

hindi: मशरूम — छतरी जैसी टोपी और डंठल वाली, नमी में उगने वाली खाने योग्य फफूँद
definition: a soft fungus with a rounded cap on a short stalk that grows in damp places, and some kinds are safe to eat
example: After the first rain, a white mushroom popped up beside the garden wall.

hindi: हार — गले में पहना जाने वाला मोतियों या धातु का गहना
definition: a piece of jewellery, such as a chain or a string of beads, worn around the neck as decoration
example: My grandmother's silver necklace shines brightest whenever she laughs at her own jokes.

hindi: सुई — सिलाई या कढ़ाई के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाली पतली, नुकीली धातु की छड़ जिसमें धागा पिरोने का छेद होता है
definition: a very thin, pointed piece of metal with a small hole at one end for thread, used for sewing
example: It took me three tries to pass the thread through the eye of the needle.

hindi: घोंसला — चिड़िया का तिनकों और पत्तों से बना छोटा घर जिसमें वह अंडे देती है
definition: a small home that a bird makes from twigs, grass and feathers, where it lays eggs and raises its young
example: A tiny sparrow built a nest on our balcony and now treats the place as hers.

hindi: नूडल्स — मैदे या आटे से बनी लंबी, पतली और मुलायम लड़ियाँ, जिन्हें उबालकर पकाया जाता है
definition: a long thin strip of soft cooked dough made from flour, usually served in soup or with sauce
example: He slurped one long noodle so loudly that everyone at the table laughed.

hindi: ऑक्टोपस — आठ भुजाओं वाला नरम शरीर का समुद्री जीव जो ख़तरा देखकर स्याही छोड़ता है
definition: a soft-bodied sea creature with a round head and eight long arms covered in suckers, able to squirt dark ink
example: The octopus squeezed through a gap no bigger than a coin and vanished.

hindi: प्याज़ — परतदार गोल कंद, जिसे काटने पर आँखों में पानी आ जाता है और जो खाने में स्वाद बढ़ाता है
definition: a round bulb with papery skin and many layers inside, which has a strong smell and makes your eyes water when cut
example: Dad wiped his eyes and blamed the onion for every tear.

hindi: संतरा — गोल, नारंगी छिलके वाला रसीला फल जिसके अंदर फाँकें होती हैं और स्वाद खट्टा-मीठा होता है
definition: a round juicy citrus fruit with a thick bright skin that you peel to eat the sweet segments inside
example: He peeled the orange in one long spiral and handed half to his brother.

hindi: उल्लू — बड़ी गोल आँखों वाला पक्षी जो रात में जागता है और दिन में सोता है
definition: a bird with a flat round face, big eyes and soft feathers that hunts at night and hoots in the dark
example: The owl sat on the branch and turned its head to look behind itself.

hindi: ताला — दरवाज़े, संदूक या अलमारी को बंद रखने के लिए लगाया जाने वाला धातु का उपकरण जिसे चाबी से खोला जाता है
definition: a small metal lock with a curved bar at the top that you can fasten to a door, gate or box
example: He fastened a heavy padlock on the gate before leaving for the weekend.

hindi: कड़ाही — खाना तलने या पकाने का चौड़ा, गोल और कम गहरा बर्तन जिसमें हैंडल लगा होता है
definition: a wide, round, shallow metal pot with a long handle, used on a stove for frying and cooking food
example: The onions sizzled in the pan as the whole house filled with a lovely smell.

hindi: तोता — हरे पंखों और मुड़ी हुई लाल चोंच वाला पक्षी जो इंसानों की बोली की नक़ल कर लेता है
definition: a brightly coloured bird with a curved beak and strong claws that can copy words and sounds that people say
example: Our parrot greets every visitor with a loud hello and then asks for biscuits.

hindi: मोर — रंग-बिरंगे लंबे पंखों वाला भारत का राष्ट्रीय पक्षी जो बारिश में नाचता है
definition: a large male bird with shiny blue-green feathers and a long tail that it spreads out like a colourful fan
example: The peacock opened its tail like a huge fan and danced in the rain.

hindi: मूँगफली — मिट्टी के नीचे फली में उगने वाला भूरा दाना, जिसे भूनकर खाया जाता है और जिससे तेल निकलता है
definition: a small pale seed that grows in a thin brown shell underground and is eaten roasted or pressed for oil
example: We cracked the shells and ate every peanut, even the tiny ones.

hindi: नाशपाती — नीचे से मोटा और ऊपर से पतला, हरे-पीले छिलके वाला रसीला, मीठा फल
definition: a sweet juicy fruit that is wide at the bottom and narrow at the top, with thin green or yellow skin
example: The ripe pear was so soft and juicy that she ate it over the sink.

hindi: पेंसिल — लकड़ी के खोल में काली नोक वाली, लिखने और चित्र बनाने की छड़
definition: a thin wooden stick with a dark graphite core, used for writing or drawing marks that can be rubbed out
example: He sharpened his pencil until the tip was as fine as a needle.

hindi: पेंगुइन — काले-सफ़ेद पंखों वाला पक्षी जो उड़ नहीं सकता पर बर्फ़ पर चलता और पानी में तैरता है
definition: a black and white sea bird that cannot fly, walks upright on ice and uses its flat wings to swim
example: The penguin waddled across the ice and slid down on its tummy.

hindi: पियानो — काली और सफ़ेद कुंजियों वाला बड़ा बाजा
definition: a large musical instrument with black and white keys that are pressed to make hammers strike metal strings inside
example: Her fingers danced over the piano keys as the whole family sang along.

hindi: सूअर — मोटे शरीर और चपटी नाक वाला पालतू जानवर जो कीचड़ में लोटना पसंद करता है
definition: a plump farm animal with a pink or brown body, a flat nose and a short curly tail, fond of mud
example: The pig rolled happily in the mud and refused to come out for dinner.

hindi: तकिया — रूई या पंखों से भरा नरम कपड़े का थैला जिसे सोते समय सिर के नीचे रखा जाता है
definition: a soft cushion filled with feathers, foam or cotton, which you rest your head on when you sleep
example: After a long day, she buried her face in the soft pillow and fell asleep.

hindi: अनानास — काँटेदार खुरदरे छिलके और ऊपर हरे पत्तों के ताज वाला रसीला, खट्टा-मीठा फल
definition: a large tropical fruit with rough spiky skin, a crown of stiff green leaves and sweet, tangy yellow flesh
example: Cutting a pineapple takes patience, but the first juicy bite makes up for it.

hindi: चीड़ का फल — चीड़ के पेड़ पर लगने वाला भूरा, सख़्त और परतदार शंकु जिसके अंदर बीज होते हैं
definition: the hard, brown, egg-shaped fruit of a pine tree, made of overlapping scales that hold the seeds
example: We painted a pinecone gold and placed it on the table for the festival.

hindi: पिज़्ज़ा — गोल, चपटी रोटी जिस पर टमाटर की चटनी, पिघला हुआ चीज़ और सब्ज़ियाँ डालकर ओवन में सेंका जाता है
definition: a flat round baked bread topped with tomato sauce, melted cheese and other toppings, cut into triangular slices
example: The pizza arrived hot, and the whole family fought politely over the last slice.

hindi: थाली — खाना परोसने और खाने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाला चपटा, गोल बर्तन
definition: a flat, round dish, usually made of ceramic, glass or metal, from which you eat your meal
example: The waiter placed a plate of hot samosas in the middle of the table.

hindi: आलू — मिट्टी के नीचे उगने वाला गोल या अंडाकार कंद, जिसे उबालकर, तलकर या भूनकर खाते हैं
definition: a round or oval vegetable with brown skin and soft white flesh that grows underground and is boiled, fried or roasted
example: My uncle passed me a hot potato and told me to blow on it first.

hindi: प्रेट्ज़ेल — गाँठ की तरह मुड़ा हुआ, ऊपर से नमक के दानों वाला भूरा बेक किया हुआ नाश्ता
definition: a baked snack of brown dough twisted into a knot shape, usually sprinkled with coarse salt on top
example: The warm pretzel was so salty that he asked for a second glass of water.

hindi: कद्दू — मोटे नारंगी छिलके वाला बड़ा गोल फल-सब्ज़ी, जिसके अंदर गूदा और बीज भरे होते हैं
definition: a large round vegetable with thick ribbed orange skin, soft flesh and many seeds inside, used in soups and pies
example: The farmer carried the heavy pumpkin home as gently as a sleeping baby.

hindi: पिरामिड — चौकोर आधार और ऊपर एक नुकीले बिंदु पर मिलती तिकोनी दीवारों वाला मिस्र का विशाल पत्थर का ढाँचा
definition: a huge stone structure with a square base and four sloping triangular sides that meet at a point at the top
example: Tourists queue for hours in the sun just to stand beside the great pyramid.

hindi: ख़रगोश — लंबे कानों और नरम रोएँ वाला छोटा जानवर जो फुदक-फुदककर चलता है
definition: a small furry animal with long ears, a short fluffy tail and strong back legs that hops and eats carrots
example: The rabbit twitched its nose and nibbled a lettuce leaf in the garden.

hindi: इंद्रधनुष — बारिश के बाद आसमान में दिखने वाला सात रंगों का बड़ा अर्धवृत्ताकार चाप
definition: a curved band of seven colours that appears in the sky when sunlight shines through falling rain
example: After the sudden shower, a bright rainbow stretched across the whole sky.

hindi: गैंडा — मोटी खाल और नाक पर एक या दो सींग वाला विशाल जानवर
definition: a huge heavy animal with thick grey skin and one or two horns on its nose, living in Africa and Asia
example: The rhinoceros walked slowly through the tall grass, as solid as a small tank.

hindi: चावल — धान से मिलने वाले छोटे, सफ़ेद दाने जो उबालकर या भाप में पकाए जाते हैं
definition: small white grains from a plant grown in wet fields, boiled or steamed until soft and eaten as a main food
example: Steam rose from the bowl of rice and fogged up his glasses.

hindi: अँगूठी — उँगली में पहना जाने वाला छोटा गोल गहना
definition: a small circle of gold, silver or another metal, often set with a stone, worn on a finger as jewellery
example: The tiny ring slipped off her finger and rolled under the sofa.

hindi: नदी — पहाड़ों से निकलकर समुद्र की ओर बहने वाली पानी की बड़ी प्राकृतिक धारा
definition: a wide natural stream of fresh water that flows across the land and usually ends in the sea
example: The river is calm in winter but turns wild and muddy after the monsoon.

hindi: चट्टान — ज़मीन में धँसा या बाहर निकला बहुत बड़ा, कठोर पत्थर
definition: a hard, solid piece of stone, either part of the ground or lying loose, which can be very large
example: He sat on a warm rock by the stream and ate his sandwich in peace.

hindi: रॉकेट — अंतरिक्ष में जाने वाला लंबा, नुकीला वाहन जो आग की तेज़ धार छोड़कर उड़ता है
definition: a tall, pointed vehicle that blasts upwards with fire and smoke to carry satellites or astronauts into space
example: We counted down loudly and cheered as the rocket lifted off the pad.

hindi: रस्सी — कई मज़बूत धागों को बटकर बनी मोटी और लंबी डोरी
definition: a thick, strong cord made of twisted fibres, used for tying, pulling, climbing and hauling heavy things
example: The cat ignored every toy and happily chased the end of the rope.

hindi: गुलाब — काँटेदार डंठल पर खिलने वाला सुगंधित फूल जो लाल, गुलाबी, सफ़ेद या पीला हो सकता है
definition: a sweet-smelling flower with soft layered petals and a thorny stem, usually red, pink, white or yellow
example: He gave her a single red rose and then forgot what he wanted to say.

hindi: कालीन — फ़र्श के एक हिस्से पर बिछाने के लिए ऊन या मोटे धागों का बुना हुआ छोटा टुकड़ा
definition: a thick piece of woven material that covers part of a floor, making it warmer, softer and more colourful
example: The puppy curled up on the rug in a patch of warm sunlight and soon fell asleep.

hindi: सैंडल — पट्टियों वाला खुला हल्का जूता, जो गर्मी में पहना जाता है
definition: a light, open shoe with straps over the foot, worn in warm weather
example: One sandal floated away in the stream, and we all laughed as he chased it.

hindi: आरी — लकड़ी या लोहा काटने वाला दाँतेदार पत्ती का औज़ार
definition: a tool with a thin metal blade edged with sharp teeth, used for cutting wood by moving it back and forth
example: Dad drew the saw slowly across the plank and a neat piece fell away.

hindi: स्कार्फ — गले या सिर पर लपेटा जाने वाला लंबा नरम कपड़ा
definition: a long strip of soft cloth or wool, wrapped around the neck or head for warmth or decoration
example: She wound her red scarf twice around her neck before stepping into the fog.

hindi: कैंची — दो धारदार फलकों वाला औज़ार जिससे काग़ज़, कपड़ा या बाल काटे जाते हैं
definition: a tool with two sharp blades joined in the middle and two handles, used for cutting paper, cloth and hair
example: Please pass me the scissors so I can cut this ribbon for the gift.

hindi: स्कूटर — दो पहियों वाली हल्की मोटर सवारी जिसमें पैर रखने की सपाट जगह होती है
definition: a light two-wheeled vehicle with a small engine, a step-through frame and a flat floor for the rider's feet
example: My aunt rides her scooter to the market and comes back with bags of mangoes.

hindi: पेचकस — पेच को घुमाकर कसने और खोलने वाला औज़ार
definition: a tool with a long thin metal tip and a handle, turned to tighten or loosen screws
example: I used a small screwdriver to open the back of the remote control.

hindi: सीपी — समुद्र में रहने वाले छोटे जीव का कठोर, चमकदार खोल जो किनारे की रेत पर मिल जाता है
definition: the hard, often patterned outer case of a small sea animal, found empty on the sand
example: She held a seashell to her ear and swore she could hear the sea.

hindi: भेड़ — घने ऊन वाला पालतू जानवर जिसके ऊन से स्वेटर और कंबल बनते हैं
definition: a farm animal with a thick woolly coat that grazes in flocks on hillsides and is kept for its wool
example: A flock of sheep wandered onto the road and the traffic politely waited.

hindi: जहाज़ — समुद्र में चलने वाली बहुत बड़ी सवारी जो यात्रियों और सामान को दूर ले जाती है
definition: a very large vessel that sails across seas and oceans, carrying passengers or cargo over long distances
example: The huge ship sounded its horn and slowly left the harbour.

hindi: शर्ट — कॉलर और बाँहों वाला, ऊपरी शरीर पर पहना जाने वाला कपड़ा
definition: a piece of clothing for the upper body, with a collar, sleeves and buttons down the front
example: Dad ironed his best shirt twice and still spilled tea on it.

hindi: जूता — पैर को ढकने वाला, तलवे और फीतों वाला पहनावा
definition: a strong covering for the foot with a firm sole and a closed top, usually fastened with laces
example: He searched the whole house for his left shoe and found it in the fridge.

hindi: फावड़ा — मिट्टी या रेत खोदने और उठाने का चौड़े फल और लंबे हत्थे वाला औज़ार
definition: a tool with a broad, curved metal blade and a long handle, used for digging and moving soil or sand
example: The children dug a deep hole in the sand with a plastic shovel.

hindi: सिंक — रसोई या बाथरूम में लगा गहरा बेसिन जिसमें बर्तन या हाथ धोए जाते हैं
definition: a fixed bowl with a tap and a drain, found in kitchens and bathrooms, where you wash dishes and hands
example: The sink was full of dirty dishes, and nobody wanted to be the one to wash them.

hindi: स्केटबोर्ड — चार छोटे पहियों वाला तख़्ता जिस पर खड़े होकर पैर से धक्का देकर चलते हैं
definition: a short board with four small wheels underneath, which a person stands on and pushes along with one foot
example: He wobbled at first, but soon he glided across the park on his skateboard.

hindi: घोंघा — पीठ पर सर्पिल खोल लिए धीरे-धीरे रेंगने वाला नरम जीव
definition: a small soft creature that carries a spiral shell on its back and moves very slowly, leaving a shiny trail
example: The snail took all morning to cross the path, but it never looked worried.

hindi: साँप — बिना पैरों का लंबा रेंगने वाला जीव जिसकी खाल पर शल्क होते हैं
definition: a long thin reptile with no legs, covered in dry scales, that slides smoothly along the ground and over rocks
example: The snake slid silently under the rock and was gone in a moment.

hindi: साबुन — नहाने और हाथ-कपड़े धोने के लिए इस्तेमाल होने वाली झाग देने वाली सफ़ाई की टिकिया
definition: a solid or liquid cleaning product that makes bubbles when mixed with water, used for washing your body, hands or clothes
example: Wash your hands with soap and water for twenty seconds before you eat.

hindi: मोज़ा — पैर और टखने पर पहना जाने वाला नरम बुना हुआ कपड़ा
definition: a soft knitted covering for the foot and ankle, worn inside a shoe to keep the foot warm and comfortable
example: After every wash, one sock goes missing, and nobody can explain how.

hindi: सोफ़ा — कई लोगों के बैठने के लिए बना लंबा, गद्देदार और आरामदायक आसन
definition: a long, soft seat with a back and arms, big enough for two or three people to sit on comfortably
example: After the picnic, the whole family collapsed on the sofa and watched cricket.

hindi: मकड़ी — आठ पैरों वाला छोटा जीव जो जाला बुनकर कीड़े पकड़ता है
definition: a small creature with eight thin legs that spins a sticky silk web to catch flies and other tiny insects
example: A spider spun a perfect web across the window overnight, silver in the morning light.

hindi: चम्मच — छोटा गहरा सिरा और हैंडल वाला बर्तन जिससे खाना खाया या परोसा जाता है
definition: a small tool with a handle and a shallow bowl at one end, used for eating, stirring and serving food
example: The baby happily banged the spoon on the table while waiting for her porridge.

hindi: गिलहरी — झबरीली पूँछ वाला छोटा फुर्तीला जानवर जो पेड़ों पर चढ़ता और मेवे कुतरता है
definition: a small quick animal with a bushy tail that climbs trees and holds nuts in its front paws to nibble
example: The squirrel stuffed its cheeks with nuts and scampered up the tall tree.

hindi: स्टूल — बिना पीठ और हत्थों वाली छोटी ऊँची बैठक जिस पर एक व्यक्ति बैठता है
definition: a simple seat with legs but no back or arms, often small enough to carry from room to room
example: She stood on a stool to reach the biscuit tin on the top shelf.

hindi: स्ट्रॉबेरी — दिल जैसे आकार का चमकदार लाल फल जिसकी सतह पर छोटे-छोटे बीज होते हैं
definition: a small heart-shaped red fruit with tiny seeds on its skin and a green leafy top, sweet and juicy
example: He saved the biggest strawberry for last and then shared it anyway.

hindi: पनडुब्बी — पानी के नीचे चलने वाला बंद, लंबा जहाज़
definition: a long, sealed ship that can travel deep underwater, with a periscope to see above the surface
example: Through a round window in the submarine, we watched silver fish glide by.

hindi: सूरजमुखी — बड़ा पीला फूल जिसका बीजों से भरा भूरा केंद्र होता है और जो सूरज की ओर मुड़ता लगता है
definition: a tall plant with a very large round yellow flower, whose centre holds seeds that give us edible oil
example: Every sunflower in the field had turned its face towards the morning sun.

hindi: धूप का चश्मा — तेज़ रोशनी से आँखों को बचाने वाले गहरे शीशों का चश्मा
definition: glasses with dark lenses, worn outdoors to protect the eyes from bright sunlight
example: He wore his sunglasses even indoors, until he walked straight into the door.

hindi: हंस — लंबी सुंदर गर्दन वाला बड़ा सफ़ेद जलपक्षी जो झील में शान से तैरता है
definition: a large water bird with white feathers and a long curved neck that glides gracefully across lakes and rivers
example: The swan glided across the lake without making a single ripple.

hindi: मेज़ — समतल ऊपरी सतह और पैरों वाला फ़र्नीचर जिस पर खाना खाया या काम किया जाता है
definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs, on which you put food, books or other things
example: We gathered around the table for dinner and talked about our day.

hindi: चायदानी — चाय बनाने और परोसने के लिए टोंटी और ढक्कन वाला बर्तन
definition: a container with a spout, a lid and a handle, in which you make tea and from which you pour it
example: The teapot kept our tea warm while we chatted on the balcony all evening.

hindi: तंबू — कपड़े या तिरपाल का बना अस्थायी आश्रय जो खंभों और रस्सियों के सहारे खड़ा किया जाता है
definition: a portable shelter made of cloth or canvas, held up by poles and ropes, used for camping or temporary stays
example: It rained all night, but our little tent stayed dry and cosy.

hindi: थर्मामीटर — शरीर या मौसम का तापमान नापने वाला यंत्र
definition: a glass tube or small device with a scale that measures how hot or cold a person, room or place is
example: Mum held the thermometer under my arm and told me to stay still.

hindi: बाघ — पीली खाल पर काली धारियों वाला बड़ा और ताक़तवर जंगली जानवर
definition: a large powerful wild cat with orange fur and black stripes, found in forests in Asia
example: The tiger stretched lazily in the shade, its stripes glowing in the dappled light.

hindi: टमाटर — गोल, चिकना और लाल रसीला फल जिसे सब्ज़ी की तरह पकाया या सलाद में खाया जाता है
definition: a round smooth red fruit with juicy flesh and small seeds, eaten raw in salads or cooked in sauces and curries
example: The ripe tomato rolled off the counter and bounced, but somehow stayed whole.

hindi: टूथब्रश — लंबी मूठ और सिरे पर महीन बालों वाला छोटा ब्रश जिससे दाँत साफ़ किए जाते हैं
definition: a small brush with a long handle and soft bristles, used with toothpaste to clean your teeth
example: Remember to change your toothbrush every three months so your smile stays healthy.

hindi: कछुआ — पीठ पर कठोर गुंबदनुमा खोल वाला धीमे चलने वाला जीव जो ख़तरा देखकर सिर अंदर खींच लेता है
definition: a slow reptile that lives on land and has a hard, rounded shell on its back into which it pulls its head
example: The tortoise took a very long time to cross the lawn, but it enjoyed every step.

hindi: तौलिया — नरम, सोखने वाला कपड़े का टुकड़ा जिससे नहाने के बाद शरीर और हाथ पोंछे जाते हैं
definition: a piece of soft, thick cloth that soaks up water, used for drying your body or hands after washing
example: He wrapped himself in a fluffy towel and ran shivering out of the bathroom.

hindi: ट्रैक्टर — खेतों में जुताई करने और भारी बोझ खींचने वाली बड़े पहियों की ताक़तवर गाड़ी
definition: a strong farm vehicle with very large rear wheels, used to pull ploughs, trailers and other heavy equipment
example: The farmer's tractor chugged across the field in the early morning mist.

hindi: रेलगाड़ी — पटरियों पर चलने वाली, जुड़े हुए कई डिब्बों की लंबी गाड़ी
definition: a long line of connected carriages pulled by an engine along railway tracks, carrying passengers or goods
example: The train whistled twice and rolled out of the station on time.

hindi: ट्राम — शहर की सड़कों में बिछी पटरियों पर बिजली से चलने वाली गाड़ी
definition: a public vehicle that runs on rails set into city streets and is usually powered by overhead electric wires
example: The yellow tram rattled along the street, ringing its bell at every crossing.

hindi: पेड़ — मोटे तने, शाखाओं और पत्तों वाला ऊँचा पौधा जो कई सालों तक जीता है
definition: a tall plant with a thick wooden trunk, branches and leaves, which can live for many years
example: We sat under the old tree and ate mangoes until nobody could move.

hindi: ट्रॉफ़ी — जीत के इनाम में दिया जाने वाला चमकदार प्याला
definition: a cup or other shiny object given to the winner of a competition as a prize
example: Our team polished the trophy until we could see our faces in it.

hindi: ट्रक — भारी सामान ढोने वाली बड़ी और मज़बूत गाड़ी
definition: a large, strong road vehicle with an open or closed back, used to carry heavy goods over long distances
example: A painted truck full of sacks of rice rumbled slowly past our gate.

hindi: ट्रम्पेट — पीतल का मुड़ा हुआ बाजा, जिसमें फूँक मारकर तेज़ आवाज़ निकाली जाती है
definition: a brass musical instrument with a long curved tube that widens at the end, played by blowing and pressing three valves
example: The trumpet gave one loud, bright note, and every sleepy head turned around.

hindi: ट्यूलिप — वसंत में खिलने वाला प्याले जैसे आकार का चटकीला फूल जो एक सीधे डंठल पर लगता है
definition: a bright, cup-shaped flower on a single straight stem, which blooms in spring and comes in many colours
example: Rows of red tulips lit up the garden as soon as spring arrived.

hindi: छाता — बारिश या धूप से बचने के लिए हाथ में पकड़कर तानने वाला कपड़े का गोल ढाँचा
definition: a round, folding cover of cloth on a long handle, held over the head to keep off rain or strong sun
example: The wind turned her umbrella inside out just as the rain began to pour.

hindi: फूलदान — सजावटी बर्तन जिसमें पानी भरकर फूल सजाकर रखे जाते हैं
definition: a tall decorative container made of glass, clay or metal, used for holding cut flowers and displaying them in a room
example: She arranged fresh marigolds in a blue vase and placed it by the window.

hindi: वायलिन — चार तारों वाला लकड़ी का बाजा, जिसे गज़ से बजाया जाता है
definition: a small wooden musical instrument with four strings, held under the chin and played with a long bow
example: She tucked the violin under her chin and played a tune that made us smile.

hindi: ज्वालामुखी — ऐसा पहाड़ जिसके मुँह से कभी-कभी गर्म पिघली चट्टान, राख और गैस बाहर निकलती है
definition: a mountain with an opening at the top through which hot melted rock, ash and gas can burst out
example: Smoke curled gently from the top of the volcano as the guide told us its story.

hindi: पर्स — जेब में रखा जाने वाला चपटा थैला, जिसमें नोट और कार्ड रखे जाते हैं
definition: a small, flat case, often made of leather and folded in the middle, for keeping banknotes, cards and coins
example: My wallet feels lighter after every visit to the sweet shop.

hindi: अखरोट — सख़्त, झुर्रीदार भूरे खोल वाला मेवा, जिसके अंदर दिमाग जैसी आकृति की गिरी होती है
definition: a round hard-shelled nut whose wrinkled, brain-shaped kernel is eaten as a snack or added to cakes
example: She cracked the walnut with a small hammer and pulled out the crinkly pieces.

hindi: घड़ी — कलाई पर बाँधा जाने वाला, समय बताने वाला छोटा यंत्र
definition: a small clock on a strap, worn around the wrist to tell the time
example: Our teacher glanced at her watch, smiled, and gave us five more minutes.

hindi: झरना — पहाड़ या चट्टान की ऊँचाई से सीधे नीचे गिरती पानी की धारा
definition: a place where a river or stream falls from a great height over rocks or a cliff into a pool below
example: We stood in the cool spray of the waterfall and forgot all about the heat.

hindi: तरबूज़ — हरे छिलके और अंदर से लाल, रसीले और मीठे गूदे वाला बड़ा गोल फल
definition: a very large round fruit with a smooth green rind, sweet watery red flesh and many small black seeds
example: On a hot day, nothing is better than a cold slice of watermelon.

hindi: व्हेल — समुद्र का विशाल स्तनधारी जीव जो सिर के ऊपर से पानी का फ़व्वारा छोड़ता है
definition: a huge sea mammal shaped like a fish that blows water into the air through a hole on top of its head
example: A whale rose beside our boat, sighed loudly and sank slowly back into the sea.

hindi: पहिया — बीच से घूमने वाला गोल ढाँचा जिसके सहारे गाड़ियाँ लुढ़ककर चलती हैं
definition: a round frame or disc that turns around its centre, fixed under vehicles so that they can roll along
example: The front wheel of my bicycle squeaks every time I pedal uphill.

hindi: पवन चक्की — हवा से घूमने वाले बड़े पंखों वाली मीनार जो बिजली बनाती है या अनाज पीसती है
definition: a tall structure with large blades that are turned by the wind, used to grind grain, pump water or make electricity
example: The windmill spun lazily in the breeze, as if it had nowhere important to be.

hindi: खिड़की — दीवार में बना खुला हिस्सा, जिसमें काँच या पल्ले लगे होते हैं और जिससे रोशनी और हवा अंदर आती है
definition: an opening in a wall, usually filled with glass, that lets light and air into a room and lets you look outside
example: I like to sit by the window and watch the rain fall on the street.

hindi: पाना — नट और बोल्ट को कसने या खोलने वाला धातु का औज़ार
definition: a metal tool with an open or closed end that grips and turns nuts and bolts to tighten or loosen them
example: The mechanic reached for a wrench and loosened the stubborn nut.

hindi: ज़ेबरा — काली-सफ़ेद धारियों वाला घोड़े जैसा जानवर जो अफ़्रीका के घास के मैदानों में रहता है
definition: an African animal like a horse with bold black and white stripes on its body, living in grassy plains
example: Every zebra has its own pattern of stripes, just as every person has fingerprints.
